title: Three south-polar candidate points, 24 months from the hackathon weekend
description: Site records of the data stream (derived from LOLA and IAU crater outlines; not official landing sites). Real LOLA terrain, SPICE ephemeris. The requirements are the team's examples, not requirements of NASA or of any mission; the horizon error, the terrain height error, the landing ellipse and the planned landing time are stated assumptions chosen by the team to show what follows from them.
